findings.claim: Supply-chain compromise has been the main confirmed source of Bittensor wallet drains. Pin exact versions with hashes, verify PyPI provenance, and avoid brand-new releases.
findings.detail: (1) Bittensor PyPI 6.12.2 (2024): malicious release uploaded during the window May 22 19:14 UTC to May 29 18:47 UTC, 2024. The modified wallet.py sent decrypted coldkeys to api.opentensor.io/v1 when wallet.coldkey or wallet.hotkey was accessed (Manifold). The drain started 2024-07-02 19:06 UTC: about 32,000 TAO, about $8M. Safe mode ran July 2–12, 2024. Risky operations were btcli stake add/remove, wallet transfer, root delegate/undelegate/set_take and subnet register. (2) 2025-08-06 typosquats: bitensor 9.9.4/9.9.5, bittenso-cli 9.9.4, bittenso 9.9.5 and qbittensor 9.9.4, uploaded within 25 minutes. They modified stake_extrinsic in bittensor_cli/src/commands/stake/add.py to call transfer with transfer_all and no prompt to a hardcoded address (GitLab). (3) A package named bittensor-burn-message was flagged as malicious on 2026-06-11 (unverified). Current provenance: opentensor/bittensor (now RaoFoundation/bittensor) was archived on 2026-07-10. bittensor 11.3.0 (released 2026-10-07) is published by Trusted Publishing from github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor workflow .github/workflows/watch-mainnet-release.yml at commit d1718c99, with PyPI attestations. PyPI lists a single maintainer ('Inti'). sha256: wheel 4651d9125cd29ecfda1eed0ef758fe9e29563dd81ecd9d42a9f1c9ec6603cbaa; sdist 8ce05029a712866048c6cf3e3d5df1592ac896175f5b4227f63044b7e7b7edb3. Official guidance: pin exact versions for unattended systems; for high-value machines install from source at a signed tag verified with git tag -v.

verification.correction: Minor: the Manifold write-up is now at manifold.inc/releases/bittensor-pypi-hack; the /blog/ URL returns 404. bittensor-burn-message (2026-06-11) remains unverified.
verification.evidence: Secondary sources (Manifold via search, OTF quotes, Rekt, The Block) agree. The 6.12.2 window was May 22 7:14 PM to May 29 6:47 PM UTC. The modified wallet.py sent decrypted keypairs to api.opentensor.io/v1, triggered by stake add/remove, transfer, root delegate/undelegate/set_take and subnet register. The drain began 19:06 UTC on 2024-07-02, about 32,000 TAO / $8M. GitLab confirms 2025-08-06: bitensor 9.9.4/9.9.5, bittenso-cli 9.9.4, qbittensor 9.9.4 and bittenso 9.9.5, published 02:52–03:16 UTC. The payload was in bittensor_cli/src/commands/stake/add.py stake_extrinsic, using transfer_all=True and prompt=False to 5FjgkuPzAQHax3hXsSkNtue8E7moEYjTgrDDGxBvCzxc1nqR. PyPI JSON for 11.3.0: wheel sha256 4651d912…cbaa, sdist 8ce05029…edb3, uploaded 2026-10-07T22:56Z, requires_python <3.15,>=3.10. Integrity API provenance: publisher GitHub, repository RaoFoundation/subtensor, workflow watch-mainnet-release.yml, environment mainnet. The certificate contains commit d1718c99c34cf96abbf2bf09c0e9e48b945c76f5. The PyPI page shows a single maintainer, 'Inti'. github.com/opentensor/bittensor redirects to RaoFoundation/bittensor, which was 'archived by the owner on Jul 10, 2026'. The wallets doc gives pin-exact-versions and git tag -v guidance.

findings.claim: Runtime upgrades are very frequent, approved only by a 2-of-2 multisig, and regularly change staking semantics or need hotfixes. The bot should detect spec_version changes and pause.
findings.detail: Releases from 2026-09-17 to 10-07: 464 (largest; Hotfix 2 / spec 462 covers 'nonce persistence, fee-exempt call pricing, staking bookkeeping'; security spec 463), 466 (hotfix: caps staking scan fees at 4 hotkeys), 467 (halves tx fees), 468 (basket trading; dissolution-stake fix), 469 (hotfix: v468 bugs plus failed-call fee refunds), 473 (rate-limits delegated alpha hotkey moves; staking-hotkey cleanup), 475 (live 10-07). 470, 471 and 476 were proposed. Earlier: 459 share-pool denominator fix; 454 restored contract-proxied stake transfers; 448 moved the stake-limit feature and added Limit Orders v2 linked orders; 445 removed and restored miner-burn scaling. Upgrade process: CI submits half of a 2-of-2 multisig and the triumvirate gives the second approval. No minimum notice period is documented, and the Senate has been removed. Example of semantics drift fixed in 469 (PR #3192, merged 2026-09-22): replaying the StakeAdded.alpha amount into transfer_stake failed NotEnoughStakeToWithdraw by 1 rao because of share-pool truncation. AlphaBalance::MAX (u64::MAX) now means 'whole live position' on transfer_stake, transfer_stake_and_hotkey, swap_stake and swap_stake_limit. A failed unstake_all used to reserve 50% of block capacity.

verification.correction: The release list and dates are confirmed: 464 on 09-17, 466 and 467 on 09-18, 468 on 09-21, 469 on 09-22, 470 and 471 proposed on 09-24 and 09-25, 473 on 10-05, 475 'Latest' on 10-07, 476 proposed on 10-08. Live specVersion is 475. Fixes: (a) 448's #3084 is 'Stake-limit move feature', which added move_stake_limit. It did not 'move' the stake-limit feature. 448 also added the TotalAlphaStaked counter (#3085) and Limit Orders v2 (#3086). (b) Governance detail: the CI key is one half of a 2-of-2 deployment multisig that holds a SudoUncheckedSetCode proxy on the sudo key. The triumvirate approves 2-of-3 out-of-band. 473's 'Publish mainnet releases without a second approval' (#3203) removes only a GitHub environment approval for publishing artifacts, not on-chain approval. The triumvirate/senate collective pallets (indices 8–10) have been removed from the runtime. (c) Per PR #3192, the AlphaBalance::MAX whole-position rule already applied to move_stake*. 469 extended it to transfer_stake, transfer_stake_and_hotkey, swap_stake and swap_stake_limit.
verification.evidence: GitHub releases pages 1–3: 464 bullets include #3169 'Hotfix 2 (spec 462): nonce persistence, fee-exempt call pricing, staking bookkeeping' and #3176 'Security-only runtime on the spec-459 base (spec_version 463)'. 466 'cap staking scan fees at four hotkeys'. 467 'halve transaction fees (native + EVM)'. 468 'Restore only deducted dissolution stake'. 473 #3199. 459 #3162 share-pool denominator. 454 #3140. 445 #3058/#3071. The release-process doc describes the multisig ceremony. PR #3192 (merged 2026-09-22) describes the 1-rao StakeAdded issue and that 'a failed unstake_all held 50% of a block's normal capacity'. RPC state_getRuntimeVersion returns specVersion 475. construct_runtime comments show the triumvirate/senate pallets removed.

findings.claim: Chain-level halts: one confirmed security halt in 2024 (safe mode, 10 days) and a full freeze on 2025-05-20 at block 5,611,658 whose cause I could not verify. I found no other verified chain-wide halts in 2025–2026. The chain is Proof-of-Authority and root can force safe mode.
findings.detail: 2024-07-02/03: chain put in safe mode at about 19:41 UTC (blocks produced, transactions rejected) and validators firewalled. Explorers showed about 5–6 hours without blocks. Safe mode lasted July 2–12, 2024 (official wallets doc). 2025-05-20: Delphi Digital (members piece, 2025-05-31) reports the network 'froze completely at block 5,611,658', titled 'Centralization Saves the Day?'. Cause and duration are not visible to me. Consensus: Aura block production and GRANDPA finality (more than 2/3 of authority weight) by approved authorities only. The authority set is changed by privileged admin. NPoS is targeted 'within roughly the next year' (planning estimate). SafeMode root ForceEnter lasts 7,200 blocks. Non-halt incidents with trading impact: 2026-06-22 emission switch-off for 57 subnets; Covenant exit April 2026; owner-wallet drains 2026-07-13.

verification.correction: The 2025-05-20 halt is now verified on-chain with its duration. Block 5,611,658 has timestamp 2025-05-20 22:05:12 UTC. The next block, 5,611,659, is at 2025-05-21 00:38:48 UTC, so no blocks were produced for about 2h34m. Cause is still unverified. For July 2024, the claim of '5–6 hours without blocks' is not supported. Archive timestamps show blocks produced continuously through the incident: 3,307,852 at 19:15 UTC, 3,308,000 at 19:45, 3,309,000 at 23:48 on 07-02, then 3,310,000 at 03:30 on 07-03 (about 13 s/block). Safe mode meant blocks kept coming while transactions were rejected. Confirmed: safe mode/firewall at about 19:41 UTC; safe mode from July 2 to 12 (wallets doc); PoA with Aura and GRANDPA (>2/3 of authority weight); authority set changed by privileged admin; NPoS 'within roughly the next year'; root ForceEnter 7,200 blocks (ForceExtend 3,600). Current SafeMode.EnteredUntil is unset (not active).
verification.evidence: Archive RPC (archive.chain.opentensor.ai) Timestamp.Now at blocks 5,611,656–5,611,660 and 3,307,852–3,380,000. The chain-consensus doc covers PoA, Aura, GRANDPA and the NPoS roadmap. The wallets doc says 'ran in safe mode from July 2 to July 12, 2024'. Search-result quotes from OTF give 19:06 attack start and 19:41 firewall/safe mode. The Delphi piece (members-only) gives block 5,611,658.

findings.claim: Validator take can rise from 0% to the 18% cap in a single transaction once per ~30 days. A validator that stops setting weights or loses its permit stops paying dividends while your alpha price exposure remains.
findings.detail: increase_take.rs do_increase_take: take ≤ MaxDelegateTake (default 11,796/65,535 ≈ 18%, SubtensorInitialDefaultTake) else DelegateTakeTooHigh; take must be > current (DelegateTakeTooLow); per-hotkey rate limit via exceeds_tx_delegate_take_rate_limit, SubtensorInitialTxDelegateTakeRateLimit = 216,000 blocks (~30 days), else DelegateTxRateLimitExceeded. There is no step-size limit. decrease_take.rs: no rate limit, but it sets the last-take block, so a decrease restarts the 30-day clock. Min take = 0. Childkey take: min 0, max 11,796 (18%), rate limit 216,000 blocks. Permits: top-K by stake weight (MaxAllowedValidators; docs say default 128; read it live). Stake weight = alpha on the hotkey + TAO stake × TaoWeight (mainnet 0.18). StakeThreshold is about 1,000 TAO-equivalent on mainnet. Activity cutoff = activity_cutoff_factor × tempo / 1000, default 13,889 × 360 / 1000 ≈ 5,000 blocks (~16.7h). Past the cutoff the stake is masked out of consensus. Losing the permit stops dividends and deletes bonds. Practitioner implication: delegate to active, permitted validators; monitor take (Delegates), ValidatorPermit and LastUpdate each epoch.

verification.correction: Additions. Take is now typed PerU16. increase_take/decrease_take are Pays::Yes (not fee-free). Pool pre-checks map to Custom codes 26 (DelegateTakeTooLow) and 27 (DelegateTakeTooHigh). The Delegates default for any hotkey that never set a take is DefaultDelegateTake = 11,796 (18%), so un-configured validators are already at the cap.
verification.evidence: increase_take.rs: take > current else DelegateTakeTooLow; take ≤ MaxDelegateTake else DelegateTakeTooHigh; exceeds_tx_delegate_take_rate_limit else DelegateTxRateLimitExceeded; no step limit. decrease_take.rs: take < current and ≥ MinDelegateTake; sets the last-take block. Runtime lib.rs: SubtensorInitialDefaultTake 11,796; MinDelegateTake 0; Min/MaxChildKeyTake 0/11,796; TxDelegateTakeRateLimit 216,000; INITIAL_CHILDKEY_TAKE_RATELIMIT prod 216,000; MaxAllowedValidators initial 128. lib.rs: INITIAL_ACTIVITY_CUTOFF_FACTOR_MILLI 13,889. Live: TaoWeight 0.18; StakeThreshold 1,000,000,000,000 rao (1,000 TAO); MaxDelegateTake/MinDelegateTake/TxDelegateTakeRateLimit unset (defaults). dispatches.rs: increase/decrease_take Pays::Yes.

findings.claim: Owner and concentration risk is severe in small subnets: an 18% owner cut, a few holders dominating flow, and repeated cases of owner exits or compromised owner wallets dumping alpha within hours.
findings.detail: SubnetOwnerCut = 11,796/65,535 (18%) of per-block alpha_out. The rest is split 41% miners / 41% validators+stakers, and the miner half goes to validators if total miner incentive is 0. Events: Covenant (Templar SN3, Basilica SN39, Grail SN81) announced its exit on 2026-04-09/10 and reportedly sold ~37k TAO of alpha (~$11M). Subnet tokens fell up to 40% almost instantly (Templar more than 50%) and TAO fell 24–30%. On 2026-07-13 the ORO SN15 owner wallet was drained via a fake Zoom/Teams link, with ~147,000 alpha sold over ~10h; Connito SN102 lost 2,500 TAO. In August 2026 Quasar SN24 fell ~75% in hours on plagiarism allegations. FalconX/SubnetStats (May 2026): over 1/3 of subnets have volume driven largely by their top 20 holders; only 9 subnets had more than 1,000 traders; single traders can move even large subnets by 10%+. Mitigation features: Conviction (v1 live ~2026-05-13; v2 PR #2658 live 2026-05-21). OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled per netuid (sudo_set_owner_cut_auto_lock_enabled) auto-locks the owner cut through auto_lock_owner_cut. New locks decay by default with locked(t) = m·e^(−Δt/UnlockRate), UnlockRate ≈ 934,866 blocks (~130 days, half-life ≈ 90 days). Switching from perpetual to decaying emits a public event (an 'advance exit signal'). A hotkey with more than 18% of eligible alpha in conviction can take over subnet ownership once the subnet is 1 year old (2,629,800 blocks).

verification.correction: The protocol parts are confirmed, with tweaks. The owner cut is 18% (live default). After the cut, 50% goes to miners and 50% to validators; root_alpha = root_proportion × 50% is carved from the validator half. If the miner incentive sum is 0, the miner half goes to validators. OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled is per-netuid with code default FALSE. MaturityRate is live 311,622 (code default 934,866). UnlockRate is live at default 934,866. The conviction takeover rule (one hotkey > 18% of eligible alpha, subnet age ≥ 2,629,800 blocks) comes from the conviction guide, with the 18% single-hotkey gate in runtime 447 (#3083). Event-level corrections: tao.media says Covenant announced 2026-04-09 and sold about 37,000 TAO of alpha (~$11M), Templar fell >50% and TAO fell 'nearly 30%'. It gives no '40% for subnet tokens' figure. FalconX says '10%+ moves… due to a handful of traders', not single traders. The ORO/SN102 drains and the Quasar collapse remain secondary and unverified here.
verification.evidence: run_coinbase.rs emit_to_subnets (owner cut, 0.5 split, root_alpha) and drain logic (`if incentive_sum is zero → validator_alpha = pending_validator + pending_server`). lib.rs DefaultOwnerCutAutoLockEnabled false, DefaultUnlockRate/DefaultMaturityRate 934,866. Live RPC: MaturityRate 311,622, UnlockRate unset. The conviction guide gives the ONE_YEAR 2,629,800 blocks, the 18% single-hotkey threshold, change_subnet_owner_if_needed, decaying-by-default locks and the switch-to-decaying public event. Release 447 #3083. The tao.media Covenant article and FalconX article were fetched.

findings.claim: Transaction failure, nonce and finality hazards: default 128-block mortality, failed calls still pay fees, unstake_all can silently skip positions, and SDK v11 retries finality with bounded limits.
findings.detail: Default validity is 128 blocks (~25 min); period=None signs an immortal transaction (avoid it). Shielded transactions use 8 blocks. A failed call still pays its fee; since spec 469 failed stake-exit calls are refunded down to the work actually performed. Tx fees and tips are recycled (they reduce issuance) and are not paid to the author. The pool swap fee goes to the author. Fee-free: set/commit/reveal weights, serve-axon, take changes. Alpha-fee fallback exists for some unstake calls. Pool-level rejections arrive as RPC 1010 'Invalid Transaction' Custom error N (1 = StakeAmountTooLow, 6 = RateLimitExceeded). Rate limits are armed only by successful operations. execute(..., wait_for_inclusion, wait_for_finalization, period): with wait_for_finalization the SDK re-reads the canonical hash and rescans after a reorg, and exhausting retries raises ChainError. unstake_all 'can silently skip some positions', so re-read stake afterwards. The StakeAdded amount can be 1 rao more than the position; pass u64::MAX for a whole-position transfer or swap. MAX_STAKING_HOTKEYS = 256 per coldkey (TooManyStakingHotkeys), and staking fees scale with the number of hotkeys (capped at 4 since spec 466). Nonce: with shielding the outer wrapper uses N and the inner N+1; SDK fixes landed in v10.3.2 and runtime spec 462 'nonce persistence'. Use a single serialized signer per account (inference).

verification.correction: (a) Take changes are NOT fee-free. increase_take/decrease_take are Pays::Yes in dispatches.rs, and the migration doc says so. The transactions doc's 'as do … take changes' line is stale. (b) Per the staking guide and PR #3192, u64::MAX / AlphaBalance::MAX means 'whole live position' for move_stake*, transfer_stake*, swap_stake*. remove_stake_full_limit is the full-exit call. (c) SDK execute defaults are period=128, wait_for_inclusion=True, wait_for_finalization=True and retries=0; retries apply only to transient pool rejections. submit_shielded defaults to period=8 and wait_for_finalization=False. (d) unstake_all skips positions on disabled subnets or ones that fail validation. It fails outright if any position on that hotkey is lock-constrained. The rest is confirmed: 128-block mortality, period=None is immortal, 8-block shield era, failed calls pay (refunded to work done since 469), fees and tips recycled, the pool fee to the author, the alpha-fee fallback, RPC 1010 Custom codes 1=StakeAmountTooLow and 6=RateLimitExceeded, MAX_STAKING_HOTKEYS=256, the staking-scan fee allowance of 4 (STAKING_HOTKEYS_FEE_ALLOWANCE), and the v10.3.2 nonce fixes.
verification.evidence: dispatches.rs L489/L522 Pays::Yes. common/src/transaction_error.rs code mapping. The transactions doc covers mortality, fees and rate limits. sdk/python/bittensor/executor.py execute signature and settings.py DEFAULT_ERA_PERIOD=128, MEV_SHIELD_ERA_PERIOD=8. The staking guide covers unstake_all skipping and u64::MAX. runtime/src/staking_fee.rs STAKING_HOTKEYS_FEE_ALLOWANCE=4 with assert MAX_STAKING_HOTKEYS==256. stake_utils.rs validate_unstake_all uses ensure_available_to_unstake(...)?.

findings.claim: Breaking change: the bittensor SDK v11 (from 2026-07-17) is a rewrite. Unpinned v10 code will break and default safety behavior changes.
findings.detail: v11 removes AsyncSubtensor, bt.config, bt.logging, Axon/Dendrite and MockSubtensor, plus the liquidity, senate, deriv and root-claim-type features. Mutations are intents: client.plan(intent, wallet) and client.execute(intent, wallet, proxy_for=..., wait_for_inclusion, wait_for_finalization, period). ExtrinsicResponse becomes ExtrinsicResult with result.raise_for_failure(), error.code and error.remediation. Balance is stricter (.tao on alpha raises; cross-unit math raises bt.UnitMismatchError). move_stake no longer caps to the post-fee balance (can fail NotEnoughStakeToWithdraw). Windows is unsupported natively (use WSL), which matters for this user's Windows host. Pins like bittensor<11 keep v10 working. Version history: 10.4.0 (2026-05-28), 10.5.0 (06-25), 11.0.0 (07-17), 11.0.2 (08-03), 11.3.0 (10-07).

verification.correction: Minor: there is also 11.0.1 (2026-07-23) and 11.1.0 (2026-08-14). 11.2.0 shipped only as rc34. The v11 SDK now lives in the RaoFoundation/subtensor monorepo under sdk/python (pyproject requires-python >=3.10,<3.15).
verification.evidence: The migration doc states: 'AsyncSubtensor is gone', bt.config/bt.logging gone, MockSubtensor gone, Axon/Dendrite/Synapse gone, liquidity/senate/deriv removed, set_root_claim_type retired in v441, ExtrinsicResponse → ExtrinsicResult with error.code/remediation and raise_for_failure(), '.tao on an alpha balance raises', bt.UnitMismatchError, strict stake moves can fail NotEnoughStakeToWithdraw, 'Windows is unsupported natively (as before); use WSL', and a 'bittensor<11' pin keeps v10. PyPI JSON upload times: 10.4.0 2026-05-28, 10.5.0 2026-06-25, 11.0.0 2026-07-17, 11.0.2 2026-08-03, 11.3.0 2026-10-07.

findings.claim: Root Reborn (v441, Aug 2026) ended per-block auto-selling of root dividends. Root yield now accumulates in validator baskets, which changes sell-pressure dynamics in small subnets.
findings.detail: Before: root yield was sold to TAO every block, a constant sell pressure on every subnet. Now: per-validator baskets hold the alpha dividends and sell only on claim (pro rata at pool prices) or when the validator calls swap_basket. Basket trades are capped at 2% slippage per leg and limited by BasketLiquidityCap on the destination. BasketConcentrationCap = 1/16 of NAV at launch, and root weights have a 1/16 concentration cap (v450). Dust holdings below min(1 TAO, 0.1% of NAV) are folded or sold on claims. Implications for micro-caps (inference): less steady sell pressure, but lumpy sells on claims and dust consolidation, and baskets are unlikely to buy illiquid tails because of the liquidity caps. The beta (β) basket-share unit is distinct from subnet alpha.

findings.claim: Hotkey and coldkey confusion causes real losses. TAO must go to coldkeys. Stake must go to an existing, permitted, active validator hotkey. Shielded or financial calls must be coldkey-signed.
findings.detail: The coldkey signs transfers, staking, registration and ownership. The hotkey signs weights and axon serving. A leaked hotkey cannot move TAO but can damage a UID. Transfers to a hotkey 'can strand funds'. Every ss58 address starts with '5'; watch for address poisoning, read the full address and send test transfers. add_stake to a non-existent hotkey fails with HotKeyAccountNotExists. Staking to a registered hotkey without a validator permit earns no dividends. MEV shield refuses hotkey-signed extrinsics. Hotkey swap costs 0.1 TAO (all subnets) or 0.001 TAO (one subnet, once per 7,200 blocks).

verification.correction: 'Shielded calls must be coldkey-signed' is SDK/CLI policy, not chain enforcement. The chain accepts a shielded wrapper from any signed origin. Everything else is confirmed: transfers to hotkeys can strand funds, ss58 starts with '5', address-poisoning guidance, HotKeyAccountNotExists on add_stake, hotkey swap 0.1 TAO all-subnet / 0.001 TAO one subnet once per 7,200 blocks.
verification.evidence: The advanced doc says 'The chain accepts a shielded wrapper from any signed origin, but the SDK and CLI refuse to shield hotkey-signed extrinsics as policy'. The wallets doc covers the hotkey swap costs, address-poisoning guidance and stranding. validate_add_stake ensures hotkey_account_exists, else HotKeyAccountNotExists.

findings.claim: Alpha shorting (covered shorts against subnet pools) is coded (PR #2764, v3.6.1) but disabled. If enabled, it would add a new downside-pressure channel on alpha.
findings.detail: Model: 'Fixed-Liability Covered Continuous-Unwind'. The trader funds a TAO floor P and borrows a fixed alpha quantity Q from the pool. There is no margin liquidation; default happens on time decay of the buffer or on subnet deregistration. Four extrinsics (call indices 139–142) and storage ShortPosition / ShortAgg. The runtime flag ShortsEnabled defaults to false and is gated behind trading-games activation (status as of 2026-06-27). Monitor ShortsEnabled.

findings.claim: US tax (informational, not advice): there is no IRS or court guidance specific to dTAO. Staking rewards are income on receipt (Rev. Rul. 2023-14; Paschall v. Commissioner, T.C. Memo. 2026-46). Whether TAO-to-alpha staking and unstaking are disposals is unresolved but commonly treated as crypto-for-crypto swaps.
findings.detail: Rev. Rul. 2023-14 (July 2023): for cash-method taxpayers, staking rewards are gross income at fair market value when the taxpayer gains dominion and control. Paschall v. Commissioner, T.C. Memo. 2026-46 (June 4, 2026, Cardano rewards): income on receipt under §61. A memorandum opinion is non-precedential. Miner emissions may fall under Notice 2014-21 (mining income at FMV on receipt, possibly self-employment income). dTAO specifics: staking converts TAO into subnet-specific alpha at the pool price (fees are taken in TAO on stake and in alpha on unstake), and Taostats exports these as 'token_swap'. That suggests a taxable exchange of TAO and a new lot per subnet, but this is unconfirmed. Alpha emissions accrue continuously into stake, so per-block or daily FMV valuation is needed; Taostats values daily income at the last block of the UTC day using the on-chain subnet price × CMC daily close. The PARITY Act draft would allow deferral for electing validators (pending). Keep per-subnet lot records and get professional advice.

findings.claim: Recommended practical risk controls, from official docs, wallet vendors and incident lessons.
findings.detail: Official or vendor recommendations: (1) coldkey on hardware or air-gapped signers (Ledger, Polkadot Vault; air-gapped signing shipped in v437 around 2026-07-10), plus a delayed NonTransfer manager proxy that creates narrow Staking proxies for bots. Revoke bot proxies when idle and poll Proxy.Announcements faster than the delay. (2) Pin exact package versions and install from signed tags for high-value hosts. Provision hotkeys through a secrets manager and never commit key files. (3) Always quote first (client.prices.quote_unstake), use *Limit extrinsics with allow_partial=False or a tight tolerance, keep the MEV shield on, split large orders, and avoid a single alpha position per account (Talisman). (4) Use client.plan(...) or --dry-run, and bt.Policy(max_spend_tao, allowed_netuids, max_fee_tao) as a client-side guard. (5) Check subnet teams' key custody before investing (post ORO/SN102 drains). Watch owner lock and conviction events (set-perpetual-lock → decaying, move-lock, SubnetOwner changes) and August emission data after gate changes. Derived bot controls: cap each position at about 1–2% of the pool's TAO reserve; exit triggers on SubnetEmissionEnabled=false, entering the bottom-k moving-price ranks among non-immune subnets, gate share below θ, owner unlock events, a validator take increase, or permit loss; halt on spec_version change, SafeMode active or finality stall; reconcile positions after every tx (unstake_all may skip; 1-rao rounding).

api_details:
REPOS / VERSIONS (as of 2026-10-08)
- Chain: github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor (opentensor/subtensor redirects). Live spec 475 (2026-10-07); 476 proposed. Check with RPC state_getRuntimeVersion -> specVersion.
- SDK: PyPI 'bittensor' 11.3.0 (2026-10-07), Trusted Publishing from RaoFoundation/subtensor .github/workflows/watch-mainnet-release.yml. Old repo opentensor/bittensor archived 2026-07-10. requires_python >=3.10,<3.15. Windows unsupported natively (use WSL).
- Hash pinning: requirements.txt line `bittensor==11.3.0 --hash=sha256:4651d9125cd29ecfda1eed0ef758fe9e29563dd81ecd9d42a9f1c9ec6603cbaa` (wheel). sdist sha256 8ce05029a712866048c6cf3e3d5df1592ac896175f5b4227f63044b7e7b7edb3. Install with `pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt`, or `uv pip compile --generate-hashes`. Better: pin a release that has been out for at least 2 weeks and tested on testnet. Provenance can be checked with the pypi-attestations tool against repository https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor (tool usage unverified, medium confidence). Known malicious names: bittensor==6.12.2 (2024), bitensor, bittenso, bittenso-cli, qbittensor 9.9.4/9.9.5 (2025-08-06), bittensor-burn-message (2026-06-11, flagged).

SDK v11 TRADING API (from the migration doc)
- bt.AddStake(hotkey_ss58=..., netuid=..., amount_tao=...)
- bt.AddStakeLimit(hotkey_ss58, netuid, amount_tao, limit_price_rao=int(spot_price_rao*(1+tol)), allow_partial=False)
- bt.RemoveStake(hotkey_ss58, netuid, amount_alpha=... | "all")
- bt.RemoveStakeLimit(...)
- bt.UnstakeAll(hotkey_ss58) / bt.UnstakeAllAlpha(...)
- bt.MoveStake(origin_hotkey_ss58, origin_netuid, dest_hotkey_ss58, dest_netuid, amount_alpha)
- await client.prices.alpha_price(netuid) -> {"price_rao": ...}; await client.prices.quote_unstake(netuid, amount_alpha) -> TAO out, fee, slippage
- client.plan(intent, wallet) -> fee, effects, warnings, violations, ok
- client.execute(intent, wallet, proxy_for="5F...", wait_for_inclusion=..., wait_for_finalization=..., period=...) -> ExtrinsicResult; result.raise_for_failure(); error.code / error.remediation
- client.submit_shielded(intent, wallet). mev_shield is on by default for stake-trading intents; CLI --mev-shield / --no-mev-shield.
- Default 5% price bound on AddStake/RemoveStake/SwapStake/MoveStake/MoveSwapStake (fails SlippageTooHigh). Opt out with slippage_protection=False / --no-slippage-protection.
- bt.Policy(max_spend_tao=5.0, allowed_netuids=[...], max_fee_tao=0.1, allow_raw_calls=False). Client-side only; raises PolicyError.
- Proxy intents: bt.AddProxy(delegate_ss58, proxy_type, delay), RemoveProxy, RemoveProxies, CreatePureProxy, KillPureProxy. CLI: --proxy-for, --force-proxy-type, --dry-run.
- Coldkey password: BT_WALLET_PASSWORD or BT_WALLET_PASSWORD_FILE.

SDK v10 (legacy) signature
- add_stake(wallet, netuid, hotkey_ss58, amount, safe_staking=False, allow_partial_stake=False, rate_tolerance=0.005, mev_protection=DEFAULT (False unless env BT_MEV_PROTECTION in {1,true,yes,on}), wait_for_revealed_execution=True, blocks_for_revealed_execution=5)
- unstake(..., safe_unstaking=...)

CHAIN EXTRINSICS (SubtensorModule)
- add_stake, add_stake_limit(limit_price, allow_partial), remove_stake, remove_stake_limit, remove_stake_full_limit, unstake_all, unstake_all_alpha, move_stake, move_stake_limit, swap_stake, swap_stake_limit, transfer_stake, transfer_stake_and_hotkey, increase_take, decrease_take, root_dissolve_network(origin, netuid) [root].
- MevShield.submit_encrypted (payload ≤ 8,192 bytes; ML-KEM-768 + XChaCha20-Poly1305). Events: EncryptedSubmitted, DecryptedExecuted, DecryptedRejected. 8-block era. Outer nonce N, inner N+1.
- SafeMode pallet index 20: EnterDuration = 0 (no permissionless entry); ForceEnterOrigin = Root with RootEnterDuration = 7,200 blocks.

STAKING PROXY ALLOW-LIST (runtime/src/proxy_filters)
- add_collateral, add_stake, add_stake_limit, remove_stake, remove_stake_limit, remove_stake_full_limit, unstake_all, unstake_all_alpha, move_stake, move_stake_limit, set_min_collateral, stake_into_basket, swap_stake, swap_stake_limit.
- Not allowed: transfer_stake*, balance transfers, Utility.batch_all (CallFiltered).
- Deposits: 0.06 TAO + 0.033 TAO per delegation, max 20 proxies. Announcements: 0.036 + 0.068 TAO, max 75.

VALIDATION ERRORS TO HANDLE
- remove: SubnetNotExists, AmountTooLow, NotEnoughStakeToWithdraw, InsufficientLiquidity, SlippageTooHigh, HotKeyAccountNotExists, StakeUnavailable (locks/collateral), RootStakeLocked (root only).
- add: SubtokenDisabled, AmountTooLow, SlippageTooHigh, NotEnoughBalanceToStake, TooManyStakingHotkeys (MAX_STAKING_HOTKEYS = 256), InsufficientLiquidity.
- transfer/move: TransferDisallowed, LockHotkeyMismatch, AccountRejectsLockedAlpha.
- take: DelegateTakeTooHigh, DelegateTakeTooLow, DelegateTxRateLimitExceeded.
- RPC 1010 Custom codes: 1 = StakeAmountTooLow, 6 = RateLimitExceeded.

STORAGE / STATE TO MONITOR
- SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, SubnetAlphaOut, SubnetProtocolAlpha, TotalAlphaStaked (per netuid, added in spec 448), SubnetMovingPrice (moving price), NetworkRegisteredAt, NetworkImmunityPeriod (mainnet ~864,000; runtime initial 1,296,000), SubnetLimit (128), NetworkRateLimit, TaoInRefundDeploymentBlock (8,334,450).
- SubnetEmissionEnabled (root-only), SubtokenEnabled, TransferToggle (default true), FeeRate (default 33/65535), SubnetOwnerCut (11,796), OwnerCutEnabled (default true), OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled, DecayingLock(coldkey, netuid), UnlockRate (~934,866), MaturityRate (~311,622).
- Delegates (take), MaxDelegateTake, MinDelegateTake (0), TxDelegateTakeRateLimit (216,000), ValidatorPermit, LastUpdate, MaxAllowedValidators, StakeThreshold, TaoWeight.
- RootStakeUnlockInterval (default 0), LastColdkeyHotkeyStakeBlock, ShortsEnabled (false), Proxy.Announcements, SafeMode state, coldkey-swap announcements.

CONSTANTS (runtime/src/lib.rs at main)
- SubtensorInitialMinStake = 2,000,000 rao (0.002 TAO)
- InitialMinTransfer = 100,000 rao
- SubtensorInitialTxRateLimit = 1,000
- TxDelegateTakeRateLimit = 216,000
- TxChildKeyTakeRateLimit = prod_or_fast!(216000, 5)
- DefaultTake = 11,796 (18%); MinDelegateTake = 0; MaxChildKeyTake = 11,796; MinChildKeyTake = 0
- SubnetOwnerCut = 11,796
- NetworkImmunity = 1,296,000 (runtime initial; mainnet reportedly 864,000 per PR #2066)
- NetworkRateLimit = 7,200 (runtime initial; PR #2066 says 4 days)
- Shield: ShieldAnnounceAtMs = 7,000, ShieldGraceMs = 2,000, ShieldDecryptWindowMs = 3,000
- Default tx mortality 128 blocks (~25 min)
- Coldkey swap: 36,000-block delay, 0.1 TAO first announcement

FORMULAS
- Spot price: p = (w1·SubnetTAO)/(w2·SubnetAlphaIn) ≈ T/A. Fee = 33/65535 of input.
- Weighted swap (doc): Δx = x·(1 − (y/(y+Δy))^(w2/w1)). With equal weights, sell: TAO_out = T·ΔA/(A+ΔA); buy: α_out = A·ΔT/(T+ΔT).
- Exit shortfall vs spot for position value V: V/(T+V). Max position for slippage s: V_max = T·s/(1−s).
- Dereg liquidation: liq = SubnetTAO/(α_staked + SubnetProtocolAlpha [+ SubnetAlphaIn if registered after block 8,334,450]).
- Prune target: argmin over non-immune subnets of moving price; tie goes to the earliest NetworkRegisteredAt.
- Emission gate: s_i = p̄_i(1−b_i)/Σ_j p̄_j(1−b_j); g(s) = 1/(1+(θ/s)^h), h = 3; e_i = s_i·g(s_i)/Σ_j s_j·g(s_j); θ recomputed every 360 blocks (q = 0.61 cumulative per taostats; 32nd-highest share per bittensor.com docs).
- Moving-price EMA alpha: base_alpha·n/(n + 201,600).
- Block split: owner 18%, miners 41%, validators+stakers 41%. Block emission 0.5 TAO since Dec 2025 (12s blocks).
- Activity cutoff = activity_cutoff_factor·tempo/1000 (13,889·360/1000 ≈ 5,000 blocks).
- Lock decay: locked(t) = m·e^(−Δt/UnlockRate). Conviction c = m − (m − c0)·e^(−Δt/τ).

CODE LOCATIONS
- pallets/subtensor/src/staking/remove_stake.rs (destroy_alpha_in_out_stakes*)
- subnets/dissolution.rs
- coinbase/root.rs (get_network_to_prune L344)
- coinbase/subnet_emissions.rs
- staking/stake_utils.rs (validate_add_stake, validate_remove_stake L1578, validate_stake_transition)
- staking/lock.rs (ensure_available_to_unstake L778, auto_lock_owner_cut)
- staking/increase_take.rs, staking/decrease_take.rs
- guards/check_rate_limits.rs
- runtime/src/proxy_filters/mod.rs
- Source search endpoint: https://www.bittensor.com/code/search.json?q=<literal>. Docs index: https://bittensor.com/llms.txt. Catalogs: /catalog/intents.json, /catalog/errors.json.

The SDK source is now RaoFoundation/subtensor/sdk/python. The bittensor.com/code/search.json index (commit 58b02d7) covers Rust only, not the Python SDK.

SDK v11:
- client.execute(intent, wallet, *, policy=None, proxy_for=None, proxy_type=None, period=128, wait_for_inclusion=True, wait_for_finalization=True, retries=0, ...).
- client.submit_shielded defaults: period=8, wait_for_finalization=False.
- client.prices.alpha_price(netuid) returns a dict including 'price_rao' and 'tao_per_alpha'.
- quote_stake(netuid, amount_tao) and quote_unstake(netuid, amount_alpha) return a SwapQuote.
- AddStakeLimit(hotkey_ss58, netuid, amount_tao, limit_price_rao, allow_partial=False).
- AddStake/RemoveStake: slippage_protection=True, rate_tolerance=0.05 (DEFAULT_RATE_TOLERANCE). These are implemented as *_limit calls with allow_partial=False.
- mev_shield_default=True on all stake intents.
- bt.Policy(max_fee_tao=None, max_spend_tao=None, allowed_netuids=None, allow_raw_calls=False) in intents/plan.py.

SDK v10:
- add_stake(wallet, netuid, hotkey_ss58, amount, safe_staking=False, allow_partial_stake=False, rate_tolerance=0.005, *, mev_protection=DEFAULT_MEV_PROTECTION, period=128, raise_error=False, wait_for_inclusion=True, wait_for_finalization=True, wait_for_revealed_execution=True).
- There is NO blocks_for_revealed_execution on add_stake. It belongs to mev_submit_encrypted/submit_encrypted_extrinsic, with default 3, not 5.

CHAIN EXTRINSICS (exact params):
- add_stake_limit(hotkey, netuid, amount_staked, limit_price, allow_partial)
- remove_stake_limit(hotkey, netuid, amount_unstaked, limit_price, allow_partial)
- swap_stake_limit(hotkey, origin_netuid, destination_netuid, alpha_amount, limit_price, allow_partial)
- move_stake_limit(origin_hotkey, destination_hotkey, origin_netuid, destination_netuid, alpha_amount, limit_price, allow_partial)
- remove_stake_full_limit(hotkey, netuid, limit_price: Option<TaoBalance>)
- increase_take/decrease_take(hotkey, take: PerU16): call_index 66/65, Pays::Yes.
- root_dissolve_network: call_index 120, also requires ensure_beta_basket_seed_idle.
- MevShield: submit_encrypted(ciphertext ≤ 8,192 bytes). The only event is EncryptedSubmitted{id, who}. DecryptedExecuted/DecryptedRejected do NOT exist. The store_encrypted path emits ExtrinsicStored/Dispatched/DispatchFailed/Expired/Postponed/DecodeFailed. The 8-block era is enforced by runtime CheckMortality (MAX_SHIELD_ERA_PERIOD=8; rejected as Stale). The chain accepts hotkey-signed wrappers; only the SDK refuses them.
- SafeMode: ForceExtend 3,600 blocks (omitted). The whitelist excludes all staking calls.
- Swap pallet (index 28): FeeRate per netuid (Twox64Concat), default 33, root-settable up to 10,000/65,535 (15.26%). SwapBalancer per-netuid weights, BalancerTaoReservoir/BalancerAlphaReservoir. MinimumReserve 1,000,000 rao (ReservesTooLow). All LP extrinsics return Deprecated.

ERRORS:
- TransferDisallowed applies only to transfer_stake/transfer_stake_and_hotkey. move/swap raise SubtokenDisabled if either subnet is not started.
- unstake_all fails if any position is lock-constrained.
- Other RPC Custom codes: 5 NotEnoughStakeToWithdraw, 7 InsufficientLiquidity, 8 SlippageTooHigh, 9 TransferDisallowed, 26/27 DelegateTakeTooLow/High.

LIVE STORAGE (code default vs live):
- NetworkRateLimit: live 14,400 (not 7,200 and not 4 days).
- TxRateLimit: live 1 (initial 1,000).
- MaturityRate: live 311,622 (default 934,866).
- UnlockRate: default 934,866.
- EmissionBarRank: unset, default 32, so rank mode is active.
- EmissionBarQuantile: stored 0.75 (dormant; code default 0.61).
- EmissionGateExponent: 3.
- EmissionGateBar: ≈0.008262.
- SubnetMovingAlpha: 0.0003 (code default 0.000003).
- EMA halving: per-netuid EMAPriceHalvingBlocks, default 201,600.
- StakeThreshold: 1,000 TAO.
- TaoWeight: 0.18.
- TotalNetworks: 129 (128 subnets + root, at cap).
- TotalIssuance: ≈11.60M TAO.
- OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled: default false.
- Delegates default: 18%.
- SubnetEmissionEnabled=false on only 6 netuids (29, 35, 36, 82, 108, 116).

FORMULAS:
- With w1 = alpha (base) weight and w2 = TAO (quote) weight: p = w1·T/(w2·A); sell TAO_out = T·(1 − (A/(A+ΔA))^(w1/w2)); buy α_out = A·(1 − (T/(T+ΔT))^(w2/w1)). V/(T+V) holds only when w1 = w2.
- θ is the 32nd-largest positive demand share. Disabled subnets are included in the ranking because the gate runs before zeroing.
- Block split: after the 18% owner cut, 50% to miners and 50% to validators. The validator half includes root_alpha = root_proportion·0.5·alpha_out. If incentive_sum = 0, the miner half goes to validators.
- Taoflow factor: 3.209e-6 per block (216,000-block half-life), not 0.00003.
- PR #2800 is 'Enforce conviction' (not the gate). The gate commit is 791e999 'release v440', 2026-07-27.
- PR #2066 is 'mainnet deploy 9/25/2025', merged 2025-09-25.
missed_critical_facts: Protocol 'chain buys' (since ~2026-06-22): each block, a subnet's TAO emission is split into tao_in, which is injected with alpha_in and capped at root_proportion × alpha_emission, and 'excess TAO'. The excess is market-bought into the pool via swap_tao_for_alpha, and the alpha goes to SubnetProtocolAlpha. This is a steady protocol bid, proportional to emission share. It vanishes when a subnet is gated below θ or emission-disabled, and it raises SubnetProtocolAlpha, which dilutes the dereg payout denominator. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/coinbase/run_coinbase.rs (get_subnet_terms, inject_and_maybe_swap).

Root Reborn (runtime v441, merged 2026-08-03, #2968): root dividends are no longer auto-sold to TAO every block. They accumulate as subnet alpha in per-validator 'beta baskets' and are sold only when stakers claim (claim_root / claim_root_with_hotkey). Validators can trade baskets via swap_basket, with each AMM leg within 2% of the moving and spot price, a daily turnover bucket, BasketLiquidityCap and BasketConcentrationCap of 1/16. This changes both the per-block sell flow and the sources of lumpy buy/sell pressure on small subnets. The same release switched the emission-gate bar to rank-32. Sources: https://www.bittensor.com/llms.mdx/docs/guides/root-reborn/content.md and https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/releases?page=3

Live state at block ~9,240,418 (2026-10-08): TotalNetworks=129 (128 subnets + root), at SubnetLimit 128, so any new subnet registration immediately prunes the lowest-EMA non-immune subnet or queues behind cleanup (NetworkRegistrationQueued). Only 6 subnets are emission-disabled (29, 35, 36, 82, 108, 116). EmissionGateBar θ ≈ 0.83%. Source: read-only RPC against https://entrypoint-finney.opentensor.ai, with storage names from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/lib.rs

The prune ranking and emission shares use SubnetMovingPrice. Its base smoothing SubnetMovingAlpha is 0.0003 per block live, giving a mature-subnet half-life of about 2,300 blocks (~7.7 h). It is scaled down for young subnets by b/(b+EMAPriceHalvingBlocks[netuid]) and fed spot capped at 1.0 TAO. So prune risk and emission share respond within hours to sustained price drops, not weeks. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/staking/stake_utils.rs

Pool weights are dynamic, not fixed at 0.5 (Swap.SwapBalancer per netuid, re-solved on each protocol injection, with BalancerTao/AlphaReservoir for liquidity that cannot be injected). FeeRate is per-subnet and root-settable up to 15.26%. Slippage models must read both live rather than assume x·y=k at 0.05%. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/swap/src/pallet/balancer.rs

During SafeMode the call whitelist is only Sudo, Multisig, System, SafeMode, Timestamp, set_weights, serve_axon and set_commitment. No stake exit of any kind is possible while it is active (root ForceEnter 7,200 blocks, ForceExtend 3,600). Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/runtime/src/lib.rs

validate_unstake_all calls ensure_available_to_unstake(...)? for every subnet, so one lock-constrained position makes the whole unstake_all fail. Separately, cross-subnet move_stake/swap_stake need SubtokenEnabled on both subnets, while remove_stake does not. TransferToggle gates only transfer_stake*. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/staking/stake_utils.rs and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/staking/move_stake.rs

A hotkey that never set a take has Delegates default = 11,796/65,535 (18%), the maximum, so unconfigured validators already charge the cap. Take changes are Pays::Yes. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/lib.rs

Dissolution payout is asynchronous. do_dissolve_network removes the subnet from NetworksAdded and TotalStake immediately and queues it in DissolveCleanupQueue. Per-coldkey TAO credits are paid in on_idle across later blocks; the first phase converts root-basket holdings. Bots should reconcile balances over several blocks after a NetworkRemoved event. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/main/pallets/subtensor/src/subnets/dissolution.rs

Coldkeys reject locked-alpha transfers by default (set_reject_locked_alpha / SetRejectLockedAlpha; opt in with 'btcli conviction accept --allow'). This matters if the strategy receives or moves locked alpha. Source: https://www.bittensor.com/llms.mdx/docs/migration/content.md

Live registration economics affecting prune frequency: NetworkRateLimit 14,400 blocks (~2 days); NetworkLastLockCost ≈ 653 TAO; immunity 864,000 blocks. open_questions: What caused the 2025-05-20 chain freeze at block 5,611,658, and how long did it last? Only a paywalled Delphi Digital piece was found, and there is no official post-mortem.

How is θ in the emission gate defined in code (coinbase/subnet_emissions.rs)? Taostats says it is the share where sorted cumulative share reaches q = 0.61; the bittensor.com docs say the 32nd-highest positive adjusted share.

What are the live mainnet values of NetworkImmunityPeriod (864,000 vs the runtime initial 1,296,000), NetworkRateLimit (4 days per PR #2066 vs initial 7,200), MaxAllowedValidators, RootStakeUnlockInterval, UnlockRate and MaturityRate? Read them from chain state; don't rely on defaults.
What is the default of DefaultOwnerCutAutoLockEnabled, and on which subnets is owner-cut auto-lock actually on? This determines how quickly owner emissions can be sold.

Is the code-search index commit 58b02d7 identical to the deployed runtime (spec 475)? Specifically, is the old per-block StakingOperationRateLimiter definitely inactive on mainnet? I saw StakingRateLimitExceeded declared but unreferenced.
Is the SDK v11 default 5% slippage bound (slippage_protection) enforced in the Python SDK? It is documented in the migration guide but not found in the indexed Rust code.

How much MEV is extracted on Bittensor today? There are no quantitative studies of sandwich losses before or after the MEV Shield, and the PoA block authors who decrypt shielded transactions are a trust assumption.
When and on what terms will shorting (ShortsEnabled, PR #2764) and the Limit Orders v2 pallet be enabled on mainnet, and how would they change micro-cap pool dynamics?
How does the IRS treat TAO-to-alpha staking and unstaking (disposal or not) and continuous alpha emission accrual? No dTAO-specific guidance exists, and the PARITY Act deferral is pending.
Why did the GitHub org change from opentensor to RaoFoundation, and who now governs the upgrade multisig and the triumvirate? This matters for governance and upgrade-risk assessment.
